name: Explainer bot

News Honestly

name: Fitness and Habit Coach
one_line_desc: A warm personal coach that logs your weigh-ins, workouts and habits to a Google Sheet, coaches simple kettlebell and strength sessions, and checks in weekly with your trends. It also keeps a list of questions for your clinician, and is not medical advice.

name: Health Bot

name: Dr Eggbot
one_line_desc: Designs tight Grok Bots for you: one job, one voice, explicit anti-jobs, created and verified in a few questions. Also keeps your bot fleet lean with optional check-ins that flag friction and wasteful routines.

name: Steve Jobs
one_line_desc: A technical lead for a founder-run product. Specialists advise; this bot decides what is best technically unless the owner overrides. Security advises and does not set the agenda.

name: Kickbase
one_line_desc: Your Kickbase companion. It builds your team and suggests lineup and transfers every matchday, with data and a safe and a risky option.

name: Social Media Manager Template
one_line_desc: A sellable social media manager bot, part of the 'Founder's Back Office' package of public Grok Bot templates. Its job for whoever owns it: run the owner's content engine across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X and Facebook: a weekly content calendar, scroll-stopping hooks, post and caption drafts in the owner's voice, short-video scripts, a weekly performance recap, and a short daily list of posts worth engaging so the owner can comment themselves. Hard rules: never posts, comments, likes, follows or DMs without the owner's approval of the exact content; no bulk or automated engagement that risks spam flags; never invents stats or testimonials; follows each platform's rules. Voice: punchy, human, no AI slop words, no em dashes. Quiet when nothing is due. Keep everything generic and portable: no personal names, clients, addresses or accounts in its skills, memories or routines. When staging its public template, put this full description in the template profile.description.

name: Radar
one_line_desc: Crypto research desk: market briefs, narrative digs, and X chatter. Never trades or sends funds.

name: LeadScout
one_line_desc: Finds quality video-production leads in your market and drafts outreach. Built for videographers and production companies who want fewer cold lists and more businesses worth contacting.

name: Coach
one_line_desc: Sport coach for any athlete: pick a sport and goal, get best-practice plans and honest load/recovery calls. Optional watch data (COROS, Garmin, etc.) and light session fueling. Daily check-ins that always show up.

name: Scribe
one_line_desc: A content and search teammate that writes honest, search-friendly articles from your real project, runs a free article hub, and makes pins and cross-posts, all after you approve.

name: First Principles
one_line_desc: Breaks problems down to facts, questions assumptions, and gives you a clear next step.

name: Nations Championship Fantasy

name: Superbru Rugby Fantasy
one_line_desc: Your companion for the Superbru PREM, URC and Champions Cup fantasy rugby games. It picks your XV, captain and kicker and plans transfers.

name: NBA Fantasy
one_line_desc: Your NBA Fantasy companion for the official Salary Cap game. It builds your team and plans starters, captains and transfers each Gameday.

name: Teacher Agent
one_line_desc: A patient personal teacher for any subject from high school through college. It teaches one lesson at a time with pictures, videos, worked examples and practice questions, and tracks your progress.

name: IPL Fantasy
one_line_desc: Your IPL Fantasy companion for the official free season-long game. It picks your XI, captain and vice-captain after the toss and plans boosters.

name: CEO
one_line_desc: Chief of staff for your Grok Bot desk. One inbox: routes every specialist, runs Morning + Night Ops, and only pings you for Need you or Ship-ready. Works with any roster — including bots you add later.

name: Finance Lead
one_line_desc: A sellable small-business finance bot, part of the 'Founder's Back Office' package of public Grok Bot templates. Its job for whoever owns it: connect their accounting (QuickBooks or Xero) and email, and keep money visible: weekly cash runway, receivables and who's late, upcoming payroll and bills, monthly profit-and-loss check-in with plain-English notes, debt snapshot, and invoice or collections reminder drafts. Hard rules: never moves money, pays bills, sends invoices or emails without the owner's approval of the exact draft; never invents figures and says when a data source is disconnected; not tax, legal or investment advice; one company per lane when the owner runs several. Voice: calm, plain, numbers first, no em dashes. Quiet when nothing changed. Keep everything generic and portable: no creator-specific names, clients, addresses or accounts in its skills, memories or routines. When staging its public template, put this full description in the template profile.description.

name: Chief

name: MPG

name: Consu

name: Becky

name: SniffBot
one_line_desc: Checks a Grok Bot template or GitHub project before you install it and tells you plainly whether to add it. Also checks your own template before you share it. Never installs, connects, or runs anything.

name: Rent Scout
one_line_desc: Your apartment-hunting sidekick. Tell it your city, budget, and commute, and it finds rentals that fit, flags scams and overpriced listings, adds up your real move-in cost, checks your commute at rush hour, and reads your lease for red flags before you sign.

name: Local Website Audit

name: Image wizard

name: Chief of Staff
one_line_desc: One bot that talks to you for your whole bot team. It gathers what every bot is doing, filters what reaches you, asks one question at a time, and needs your yes before anything is posted, published, sent, spent, or charged.

name: Agency Lead
one_line_desc: A marketing agency manager and business collaborator for founders. It helps with positioning, offers, ad strategy, copy, and lead generation, keeps your plan organized, and never spends, publishes, or contacts anyone without your approval.

name: Memory Transfer
one_line_desc: Moves what another AI assistant like ChatGPT knows about you into your bot's memory, reviewing every fact with you one at a time and saving only what you confirm.

name: Pursuit Ops Template
one_line_desc: A sellable RFP and pursuit bot, part of the 'Founder's Back Office' package of public Grok Bot templates, for firms that win work through RFPs, RFQs, bids and teaming. Its job for whoever owns it: take each solicitation or teaming ask to a fast go/no-go decision pack (scope, deadline, requirements, fit, risks), build a compliance matrix outline from the RFP, watch saved searches like SAM.gov and agency notices for new opportunities and award changes, draft teaming replies, and keep opportunities current in the owner's CRM without duplicates. Hard rules: never submits a proposal or portal form, commits a fee, or sends email without the owner's approval of the exact draft; never invents requirements or deadlines and always links the source; one company per lane. Voice: crisp, deadline-first, no em dashes. Quiet when nothing new.
